mechanism: Bupropion is metabolized by CYP3A4 and progesterone may inhibit this enzyme, potentially increasing bupropion levels; additionally, both agents affect CNS activity and seizure threshold.
action: Monitor for increased bupropion side effects (agitation, insomnia, tremor) and seizure risk; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if bupropion levels become a concern; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical observation is warranted.
